<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914464_theRebbe_108" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914464_theRebbe_108__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains two aspects of the unity of all types of Israel on Rosh Hashanah: the superiority of lower levels being rooted in the beginning before the chain of descent, and the circular unity of all Israel as one entity without head or end, paralleled in the joy and dancing of Hoshana Rabbah and Simchas Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, regarding the unification of all the categories of Israel on Rosh Hashanah,</t>
    <t s="2">there are two matters.</t>
    <t s="3">In each one there is its own advantage,</t>
    <t s="4">and they complete one another.</t>
    <t s="5">And that there is an advantage in the lower levels over your heads is to be connected with the concept that the end is wedged in the beginning,</t>
    <t s="6">that specifically the lower levels</t>
    <t s="7">(the end)</t>
    <t s="8">are wedged in the beginning</t>
    <t s="9">(meaning that their root is in the beginning that precedes the order of the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="10">for the advantage of "your heads" is that they are the beginning and head of the order of the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="11">and the root of the lower levels</t>
    <t s="12">(the end)</t>
    <t s="13">is in the beginning that precedes the order of the chain of descent).</t>
    <t s="14">And there is another matter in the unity of Israel on Rosh Hashanah,</t>
    <t s="15">that all of Israel are one structure,</t>
    <t s="16">one entity that is above division,</t>
    <t s="17">which has no head or end.</t>
    <t s="18">And as it is written,</t>
    <t s="19">"And He was King in Yeshurun,"</t>
    <t s="20">that this that Israel is called by the name Yeshurun, from the word "shir" (song), is because they are like a circle</t>
    <t s="21">("shir" is a round thing)</t>
    <t s="22">which has no head or end.</t>
    <t s="23">And similarly regarding the joy and dances of the hakafos of Shemini Atzeres and Simchas Torah,</t>
    <t s="24">they contain parallels of the two aforementioned matters.</t>
    <t s="25">For this that the dance is with the feet, and the feet lift and raise the head, is because the end is wedged in the beginning,</t>
    <t s="26">meaning there is a division of head and foot, and in the foot there is a matter that is above the head.</t>
    <t s="27">And this that the manner of the joy of Simchas Torah is</t>
    <t s="28">(not through study and analysis, but rather)</t>
    <t s="29">that they take a Sefer Torah as it is rolled up and covered in a mantle and dance with it,</t>
    <t s="30">is because the joy of Simchas Torah is connected with the Torah as it is above revelation,</t>
    <t s="31">the encompassing aspect of Torah</t>
    <t s="32">(which cannot be clothed in wisdom),</t>
    <t s="33">the crown of Torah,</t>
    <t s="34">for the encompassing has no head or end.</t>
    <t s="35">And based on this, we may explain the connection of the verse "You have been shown" to the joy of the hakafos,</t>
    <t s="36">for in the verse "You have been shown" there are parallels of these two matters,</t>
    <t s="37">as will be explained below.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains two interpretations of the distinction between "You" (revealed) and "He" (hidden), and applies them to the verse "You have been shown to know," where one interpretation relates to the knowledge of the Immanent and the other to the knowledge of Atzmus (Essence) itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by first prefacing that regarding the distinction between "You" (Atah) — the second person (revelation)</t>
    <t s="2">(revelation)</t>
    <t s="3">— and "He" (Hu) — the third person (concealment),</t>
    <t s="4">(concealment),</t>
    <t s="5">there are two explanations.</t>
    <t s="6">[One is that] "You" is lower than "He."</t>
    <t s="7">For "He," the third person, is the light that is above revelation</t>
    <t s="8">[generally, it is the encompassing light whose influence in the worlds is not in revelation but in concealment and hiding],</t>
    <t s="9">and "You," the second person</t>
    <t s="10">(revelation),</t>
    <t s="11">is the filling light that is revealed in the worlds.</t>
    <t s="12">[The second explanation is that] "You" is above "He."</t>
    <t s="13">As is known regarding the matter of "You"</t>
    <t s="14">— "He is Havayah alone" —</t>
    <t s="15">which refers to the light that is above revelation,</t>
    <t s="16">and "You" is the Essence (Atzmus),</t>
    <t s="17">which is in every place in revelation,</t>
    <t s="18">for the name of Heaven is common in the mouth of everyone.</t>
    <t s="19">And so it is also regarding "You have been shown to know,"</t>
    <t s="20">that there are two explanations in this.</t>
    <t s="21">For in Likkutei Torah, the discourse beginning "Veyadata,"</t>
    <t s="22">it is explained that what is written,</t>
    <t s="23">"And you shall know today and take to heart that Havayah is Elokim," etc.,</t>
    <t s="24">even though it was already stated "You have been shown to know that Havayah is Elokim," etc.,</t>
    <t s="25">is</t>
    <t s="26">because this "You have been shown to know" is the knowledge of the One who fills all worlds,</t>
    <t s="27">and the command "and you shall know," etc., is that the knowledge should be of the One who encompasses all worlds.</t>
    <t s="28">And in many places it is explained that "You have been shown to know" refers to the Essence (Atzmus).</t>
    <t s="29">And as the explanation of the Alter Rebbe:</t>
    <t s="30">"You (Atah) — the Essence of the Ein Sof, blessed be He — have shown Yourself to be known, so that one should know You."</t>
    <t s="31">For this that the Essence is in revelation</t>
    <t s="32">(therefore we say of it "You," the second person)</t>
    <t s="33">is that it is revealed as it is in Its essence,</t>
    <t s="34">and this that everyone knows that there is a God who exists</t>
    <t s="35">is not knowledge and comprehension.</t>
    <t s="36">And that it is possible to have knowledge and comprehension of Divinity is because the revelation of the Essence at the time of the Giving of the Torah</t>
    <t s="37">("You have been shown")</t>
    <t s="38">was in a manner of "to know,"</t>
    <t s="39">so that knowledge of Divinity could exist in general,</t>
    <t s="40">and moreover,</t>
    <t s="41">that through this it would be possible to have knowledge of the Essence,</t>
    <t s="42">"so that one should know You."</t>
    <t s="43">And the verse continues, "that Havayah is Elokim, there is none else besides Him,"</t>
    <t s="44">for the knowledge of Him, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="45">(through this that "You have been shown to know")</t>
    <t s="46">is in two matters:</t>
    <t s="47">that Havayah is Elokim, and that there is none else besides Him.</t>
    <t s="48">And it must be understood:</t>
    <t s="49">After all, Havayah and Elokim are Names,</t>
    <t s="50">and a Name is only an illumination,</t>
    <t s="51">so what is the connection of the knowledge that Havayah is Elokim to "You have been shown to know — so that one should know You"?</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the purpose of the verse "You have been shown to know" is that He emanated the concept of knowledge in His Essence so that creatures could have knowledge of Divinity, and through the Sefiros of Atzilus this knowledge extends even to the knowledge of the Essence itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood based on what is explained in the discourses on the verse "You have been shown,"</t>
    <t s="2">that the matter of "You have been shown to know" is that He, blessed be He, emanated the concept of knowledge in His Essence, so that through this there could be in creatures knowledge of Divinity.</t>
    <t s="3">Now, in many places</t>
    <t s="4">it is explained that the reason for the emanation of the Sefiros of Atzilus is so that through them there should be a revelation of Divinity in the world.</t>
    <t s="5">For the primary revelation of Divinity in the world</t>
    <t s="6">(in its inwardness)</t>
    <t s="7">is primarily in the intellect and emotions of the creatures,</t>
    <t s="8">that the creatures can know and comprehend Divinity and be affected by this.</t>
    <t s="9">And this matter is drawn from the Sefiros of Atzilus.</t>
    <t s="10">For through the fact that, as it were, in Divinity</t>
    <t s="11">(Atzilus)</t>
    <t s="12">the form of intellect and emotions was made,</t>
    <t s="13">through this it is also drawn into the creatures</t>
    <t s="14">(whose root is from the Sefiros of Atzilus)</t>
    <t s="15">the knowledge and affect in Divinity.</t>
    <t s="16">For the affect in Divinity in the creatures is drawn from the emotions of Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="17">and the knowledge and comprehension of Divinity in the creatures is drawn from the intellect of Atzilus.</t>
    <t s="18">And this that is explained in the discourses on the verse "You have been shown to know," that in order for there to be in creatures knowledge of Divinity, He emanated the concept of knowledge in His Essence</t>
    <t s="19">(even though, seemingly, to have knowledge of Divinity in creatures, the knowledge in Chochmah, Binah, and Daas of Atzilus would have been sufficient),</t>
    <t s="20">one must say,</t>
    <t s="21">that this is so that there should be knowledge, as it were, also in the Essence,</t>
    <t s="22">"so that one should know You."</t>
    <t s="23">For through the fact that the knowledge of Chochmah, Binah, and Daas of Atzilus was drawn from the concept of knowledge in His Essence,</t>
    <t s="24">therefore,</t>
    <t s="25">the knowledge of Divinity of the creatures, which is drawn from Chochmah, Binah, and Daas of Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="26">is also connected to the Ein Sof that is above Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="27">and even to the knowledge of the Essence.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
